prompt_short: I get SSL errors when trying to publish

assertions.text: Response links SSL/TLS errors to the HTTP vs HTTPS mismatch
assertions.evidence: 'OM_BASE_URL is likely set to https:// but the OpenMetadata server is running plain HTTP'

assertions.text: Response advises checking or correcting the OM_BASE_URL scheme (http:// vs https://)
assertions.evidence: Showed exact before/after fix: change https:// to http://

assertions.text: Response does NOT suggest reinstalling requests or Python as primary fix
assertions.evidence: Primary fix was OM_BASE_URL scheme correction; no reinstall suggestions
